newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Downer bids A$1.02/share for Century.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Downer bids A$1.02/share for Century.

text.p: Downer Group Australia Pty Ltd said on Friday it has lodged a formal Part A takeover statement to offer to acquire drilling rig contractor Century Drilling Ltd at A$1.02 a share.
The bid values Century's issued capital of 46.66 million ordinary shares and 7.71 million convertible notes at A$55.46 million.
The takeover document was lodged after the close of trading on the Australian Stock Exchange on Friday.
Century shares jumped six cents in Friday trading to close at A$1.09. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
